column3: If everyone could just look the other way, that'd be swell.

column3: Dead meat. Yuck. How could anyone want to eat such a thing?

column3: Well, that just destroyed my chances of being reincarnated as something nice. I am sorry, friend, for taking your life by accident. I will suffer through the karmic wheel for you.

column2: Тело устало! Сейчас самое время поспать.
column3: I'm beat. I could use some sleep.

column3: Ja, sehr gut! Enemy defeated in this area.

column3: That Fox is one hell of a broad. She's got a killer pair of guns on her, too.

column3: Come on! What's this? Look, let me polish this thing up a bit.

column3: Center yourself. Breathe. Let the negative energy flow away from you.
This one's going down like a prom queen.

column2: Наверно, у них была очень плохая карма.
column3: They must have acquired some really bad karma.

column2: Ты молодец! Продолжай верить в себя!
column3: Good for you! You should be proud of yourself!
I am having too much fun shooting right now.

column2: Gott im Himmel, моё оружие неисправно.

Ya mon! That be the last of them.
This is a bad place to be!

column2: Аура Айса вдохновляет всех, кто её видит.
column3: Ice has the kind of aura that inspires greatness.

column2: У этой вещи грязная аура. Её нужно чистить. Долго.
column3: The aura surrounding this thing is corrosive. It should be cleansed. Repeatedly.
We're down to the last unfriendly, chief.

column2: А вот так НЕ ДЕЛАЙТЕ. И не заставляйте меня повторять.
column3: That's what you're NOT supposed to do. Don't make me show you again.

column2: У меня есть план, как помочь нам раскрыть наш потенциал. Вот, смотрите.
column3: I've got a to-do list here to help us unlock our potential. Take a look.
Got this perp pinned in place.

column2: Шеф, я так долго не смогу. Мне б врача.
column3: Can't keep going like this, chief. I need a medic.

column2: Я думала, со мной такого никогда не произойдёт.
column3: I never thought something like that could happen to me.

column2: Ох... Такой подарок должен быть в обёртке!
column3: Oh, mon... Something so fine should come with a card.
Keeping a watch over the pups.

column3: Jeezum Pees! I don't think I gonna make it, mon!

column2: У нас ещё будет время познакомиться с новыми людьми, когда закончим убивать старых.
column3: There will be time to connect with new people once we're done killing these other people.

column2: Учитесь у мудрого Омрына. Даже промахиваясь, он не напрягается.
column3: Look at wise Omryn. Even when he misses, he is so relaxed.

column2: Да нас из муниципального бюджета лучше снабжали.
column3: I got better equipment while on public funding.

column2: Здесь полно преступников. Пора заняться любимым делом.
column3: Got a lot of perps here. Guess I'll get comfy and do my thing.

column2: Всё в порядке, милый! Я на подхвате!
column3: Don't worry, hon! I've got you covered!

column2: Ну-ка, все - сделайте вдох и сбалансируйте свои чакры.
column3: Everyone needs to breathe and realign their chakras.
The three C's: Concealed, Clean, Quiet.
You line 'em up, I take 'em down.

column2: Шеф, мне бы здесь помощь не помешала!
column3: I could use a little help here, chief!
Get ready for a wolf bite, baby.

column2: Твою ж... ОХ! Что-то мне совсем хреново.
column3: Fucking... OW! I'm in real bad shape here.

column2: Отсюда я промахнулась бы и в самый удачный день!
column3: I'd probably miss that one on my best day.

column2: Будьте готовы. Они ждут момента, когда мы расслабимся.
column3: Be prepared. They'll probably pop out the moment we drop our guard.
Racking up the body count here.
Looks like they pulled out. Sector's secure.

column3: That be a sad day. I am getting too deadly for my own good.
Well, I guess they ain't using paint balls!

column3: I feel good vibes from thinking about this task. I will do it with pleasure.

column3: My horoscope warned me I would end up in this position.

column3: I'm going to commune with my pillow. Lots more productive after a few winks.
I am one with the stillness of everything.

column3: The enemy has deserted the area. It is ours by default.
How... Well, I guess you can't hit 'em all.
Don't be messin' with my tools.

column2: Ха... Оказывается, я и в самом деле круче, чем думала.

Scheisse! The enemy has spotted me.

column2: Мда, сборы псу под хвост. Как насчёт в следующий раз действовать КОМАНДОЙ?
column3: Well, that exercise was a bust. Maybe next time we can try actually working as a team?

column2: Прибыл на место и готов к самосовершенствованию.
column3: I have arrived at the destination and am ready for a new goal.

column2: Ладно, прочешем местность. Если тут что-нибудь есть, мы это найдём.
column3: All right, let's comb this place. If there's something here, we'll find it.

column2: Ты стать бы ещё лучше, не смотри ты девушкам под юбки.
column3: You be pretty good when you don't try to look up someone's skirt.

column2: Контракт заканчиваться, правда. Хочешь меня - я буду в мастерской.
column3: The contract is up, mon. If you need me again, I be back at my shop. I see you.

column2: Жуть, правда? Мне прямо самой от собственных успехов страшно.

column3: Visualize wealth and wealth will come to you.

column3: And that's how a commando does it. Hope you were taking notes.
Try and top that! Just try!
Time for a resupply of lead.

column2: На мне живого места не осталось. Похоже, я не выкарабкаюсь.
column3: I'm way beyond wounded. Don't think I'm gonna make it.
Well, I guess somebody must've tripped an alarm!

column2: Это моя работа. И я делаю её чертовски хорошо.
column3: That's what I do and I'm really, really good at it.

column2: У меня упадок энергии. Я должен помедитировать.
column3: My energy is low. I need to stop and meditate soon.
I'm getting a lot of attention!
